about: Every reason name the backend may send in an hour's "reasons" (condition), and the topics that come with two of them. The backend's tests check it sends nothing else; the app's and the website's tests check each has a label and a sentence of its own. A new reason: add it here first, then to the backend, Models.swift (Reason.baseLabel, baseExplanation) and shared.js (baseLabel, reasonExplanation), and a tile in logic.js REASONS. Older app builds show an unknown name as "Other condition".
